background: NatWest Markets is the non-ring-fenced bank of NatWest Group, providing rates, currencies and financing to the group's corporate and institutional clients, funded by wholesale markets and the parent.
synthesis: Fitch rates the bank AA after its upgrade on 12 May 2026, S&P A and Moody's A1, all stable, and DBRS moved it to a positive outlook on 16 Sep 2026. Capital is strong against UK majors, with CET1 of 18.3% in the top quarter and up 1.2 points since 30 Jun 2025, while leverage of 4.9% is just above the peer median but down 0.7 points. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 204% is in the top quarter and up 11 points, but NSFR of 122% is in the bottom quarter, the weak spot for a wholesale-funded bank.
